HexKagune 6.2.2 for Forge 1.20.1 (needs PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon on clients; the server needs only Forge). Install on both the client and the server; everyone on a server needs this jar.

**Instant Big Punch (Witness This)**
- New switch in the menu, on the Witness This card once it is unlocked: **INSTANT BIG PUNCH: ON/OFF** (off by default; it is saved).
- On: a tap of Z is the full-charge Big Punch at once. She blinks to the target and goes straight into the Witness This combo, with no charging. One punch per press.
- Off: Z charges as before.

**Witness This, bigger and easier to follow**
- The sphere is bigger: each blow knocks the target 11 blocks (was 7.5), so it is batted around a space about 28 blocks across, and the uppercut throws it 13 blocks up (was 9).
- Slower: one blow every 5 ticks (was 3), with a longer wind-up before each blow. A slower uppercut climb. The target also turns over at less than half the speed.
- The juggled body reacts to every blow: it snaps over the way it was struck, and its head whips round and back.
- Her head no longer jerks around during the combo. It stays square on her body, looking at the target.
- Fix: the target no longer lands, lies down and gets up in mid-air partway through the combo.

**Dashes are unseen**
- Nothing can hit her during the approach of a dash: the Speed Kick (and the Owl's), the Big Punch blink and all of Witness This, until her blow lands.
- The target is stunned from the moment she dashes or blinks at it, so iron golems and other mobs can no longer swing first.
